requirements.description: Marble Race runs six equally fast marbles that finish in a uniformly random order on the shared exactly-once settlement core. A race debits one bounded play-token stake on one of two markets: a win bet backs a marble to finish first and pays five point seven times the stake, and a podium bet backs a marble to finish in the top three and pays one point nine times the stake. The true odds are five to one and even money, and each payout applies a five percent track takeout, so both markets return 0.95 on average for a house edge of five percent. Unknown markets, out-of-range marbles, and non-integer, non-positive, or over-limit stakes are rejected before any wallet movement.
requirements.notes: Allocated for GitHub issue #157, a catalog-expansion game (#73). The module supplies only pure rules; the shared core owns settlement. Issue #1009 delegates route, busy, locale, request-id, and external stylesheet ownership to the shared lifecycle without changing the track, markets, semantic marble colors, 1,300 ms race timing, settlement, DOM, or visible layout.

requirements.description: Marble Race inherits the shared core's exactly-once settlement: one caller-stable request id maps to one race, a retry replays the identical committed finishing order and payout without moving the wallet again, and a request id reused with different wager content fails closed. The additive v1 contract exposes only the game-owned state and races routes and never alters the frozen shared API. Every race commits a full six-marble finishing order, and the published bet catalog reports honest marbles, podium size, and multipliers.
requirements.notes: Allocated for GitHub issue #157. Issue #1009 preserves the exact state and races endpoints, caller-stable request payload, committed wager rendering, wallet refresh, reload recovery, and real repeat flow while removing duplicate frontend lifecycle helpers.
